subject: Vanguard Systems — SIG/CAIQ kickoff & evidence prep
messages:
From: Alex Porter <aporter@vanguard-systems.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: Sabrina Cho <sabrina.cho@vanguard-systems.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG+CAIQ kickoff — proposed times & preliminary artifact list

Hi Maya,

Thanks for taking this. Vanguard is preparing a SIG/CAIQ review as part of our platform evaluation (SOC 2 follow-up to come). We'd like to kick off with a 45–60 min session to walk through scope, evidence mapping, and any CAIQ-specific clarifications.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 2027-05-26, 10:00–11:00
- Thu 2027-05-27, 09:00–10:00

Initial asks from our side:
- A short prep doc or checklist (what Redwood will share during the call)
- A high-level mapping of which artifacts correspond to SIG control families (ex: logging, key mgmt, network)
- Any list of sample logs/artifacts we should request access to (S3 paths, syslog examples)

Attendees from Vanguard: Sabrina Cho (security lead), myself (security eng).

Can you confirm availability and share anything you recommend we have ready?

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Porter
Senior Security Engineer
Vanguard Systems
From: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <aporter@vanguard-systems.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG+CAIQ kickoff — proposed times & preliminary artifact list

Alex — thanks, Wed 5/26 10:00 PT works for us. Invited Marissa (security & SOC2) and Ben (solutions eng) to cover evidence cadence and deployment questions.

I've attached a short SIG prep checklist (redwood_sig_prep_checklist.pdf) and a CAIQ mapping snapshot to the invite. Quick pointers for Vanguard to prepare:
- Evidence owners: name & email for buckets (logs, keys, infra architecture, deployment config)
- Example log window: a 24–48 hour sample of request/response traces and audit logs (redact IPs if required)
- If you're evaluating Private/VPC deployment, list any in-scope CIDR or peering constraints up front

Agenda for the 45m session:
1) 10m: scope & timelines (SIG vs full CAIQ vs SOC 2 artifacts)
2) 15m: artifact mapping (what we can provide vs. what we ask you to extract)
3) 15m: open Q&A (KMS, key rotation, audit logs, data residency)
4) 5m: next steps & owners

Drive prep doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSIGPrep
Attaching: redwood_sig_prep_checklist.pdf (stub).

See you Wed — please share evidence-owner names ahead of the call if possible.

Best,
Maya

--
Maya Srinivasan
Security Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <aporter@vanguard-systems.com>, Sabrina Cho <sabrina.cho@vanguard-systems.com>
Cc: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-26T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Notes: 2027-05-26 SIG/CAIQ kickoff (Vanguard) — summary & action items

Alex / Sabrina — thanks for the call today. Below is a short capture of decisions, clarifications, and concrete action items. I included short excerpts from the call where we clarified evidence expectations.

Meeting highlights:
- Scope: initial review focused on CAIQ v3 mapping and SIG-L1 control families. SOC 2 preliminary check; formal SOC 2 report discussion deferred to later (post-eval).
- Deployment modes discussed: Redwood Hosted (default) vs Dedicated vs Private (VPC). Vanguard is primarily evaluating Hosted with a potential Dedicated contract for production.
- Key evidence Vanguard requested: KMS key rotation policy, audit log samples, VPC peering config (if Private is considered), system activity logs showing admin actions.

Call excerpt:
"Alex: 'We need to see a sample of token-level audit trails and a retention policy for KV cache logs.'
Maya: 'We can provide a 72-hour anonymized token-trace and our audit-log retention matrix; retention longer than 90 days is on the enterprise plan.'
"

Action items (owner — due):
- Alex / Vanguard: share evidence roster with point-of-contact per artifact (logs, keys, architecture) — due 2027-05-27 (Vanguard provided vanguard_evidence_roster.xlsx in follow-up).
- Marissa: provide CAIQ control-to-artifact mapping spreadsheet and highlight any controls requiring customer-supplied logs — due 2027-05-28 (marissa will post link).
- Ben: prepare short note on KMS integration & key-rotation evidence we can produce (include sample policy text and Cloud KMS export steps) — due 2027-05-29.
- Maya: schedule a 60m deep-dive for SOC2 scoping once Vanguard confirms roster — tentative week of 2027-06-07.

Artifacts we agreed to share from Redwood:
- Anonymized token-trace sample (72 hrs) — will be provided as logs (S3 path) with redaction guidance.
- Audit-log retention matrix & SOC2 control owners list (pdf).
- CAIQ mapping (spreadsheet) that links SIG control IDs to Redwood artifacts.

Notes on sensitive items:
- Any log export will be filtered to remove customer payloads and IPs. For Private deployments, we will coordinate a time-limited S3 share or temporary presigned URLs.

Next meeting: SOC2 scoping (60m) — tentatively week of 2027-06-07 pending roster.

Regards,
Marissa

--
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Porter <aporter@vanguard-systems.com>

Subject: Re: Notes: 2027-05-26 SIG/CAIQ kickoff (Vanguard) — summary & action items

Thanks Marissa — attaching the evidence roster (vanguard_evidence_roster.xlsx). Per the roster:
- Logs owner: Sabrina Cho (sabrina.cho@vanguard-systems.com)
- Architecture diagrams & network: Chris Lee (chris.lee@vanguard-systems.com)
- Legal & contracts: Priya Anand (priya.anand@vanguard-systems.com)

We confirmed Vanguard is happy to receive an anonymized 72h token-trace via presigned S3 link and would prefer redaction on IPs and any PII.

Next steps from our side: Sabrina will add timestamps for the requested 72h window and share access instructions by EOD 2027-05-28. If you need a signed DPA addendum before log sharing let us know and we'll loop Legal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the CAIQ mapping.

Best,
Alex
